name: Admin Diagnostic Mark In Analysis
description: Admin clicks 'Marcar en análisis' on a SENT diagnostic to acknowledge that the client authorized continuing — opens a ConfirmModal and POSTs /api/diagnostics/:id/mark-in-analysis/, transitioning SENT → NEGOTIATING. The button is only available after `initial_sent_at` is set; afterwards the 'Enviar diagnóstico final' action becomes the next user step.
